prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Full stack developer - Vue3, NodeJS, postgres
Notes/preferences: - No agencies please (please expect no response if you are or linked with agency) - You must be a "Verified" freelancer - Long term - Initially for 5 weeks followed by extensions (UK timings) - Excellent experience with Vue 3, Node.JS, NuxtJS, postgres, Quasar, Typescript, APIs, others - Good architectural exposure/experience - Experience in agile to keep up with the changing requirements - Inclined to move fast and iterate rather than wait for perfection Preference: - Experience in PWA, payment, real time tracking, chat, call, etc. - Experience in Google analytics - API integration, dashboards - Not too much engaged with other projects Responsibilities: - Work on a large, complex projects - Translate Wireframes and high fidelity design (Figma) - Design, implement, and test application code - Work on API integration - Write code that is cross-platform and cross-device compatible - web/PWA/dashboards - Define/implement db changes - Ensure performance, scalability, security etc.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Prefer broad claims like 'extensive experience' over specifics.
- Keep it under 150 words.
- End with one specific question about the job.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working full stack developer with 7 years of experience building web applications with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS.

I’m comfortable working on large, complex products, translating Figma wireframes into clean, cross-platform interfaces, and handling API integration, database changes, performance, scalability, and security. I also work well in agile environments where requirements evolve quickly and iteration matters more than perfection.

While my background is strongest in React and Next.js, I bring solid full stack experience and a practical architectural mindset that helps me move fast and keep code maintainable.

Are you open to a developer who can contribute quickly from week one and stay available for the full 5-week initial period?
